blocks.text: Visual web development platform that eliminates the gap between design and code

Webflow occupies a unique space in the no-code landscape: it gives designers the power of code without writing a single line. Unlike template-heavy builders, Webflow generates clean, semantic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript - meaning your site performs well and remains maintainable as you scale.

For startup teams, the real unlock is speed-to-market. You can go from wireframe to published site in days instead of weeks, with full creative control over every pixel. The built-in CMS handles blogs, case studies, and dynamic content, while native hosting on AWS and Fastly's CDN means you never worry about infrastructure.

Where Webflow truly shines is at the intersection of marketing and product. Marketing teams can update copy, launch landing pages, and run A/B tests without bothering engineering - freeing your developers to focus on the core product.
Build responsive sites with a visual canvas that generates production-ready code
Dynamic content management for blogs, portfolios, product listings, and more
Create scroll-triggered animations and micro-interactions without JavaScript
Fast, reliable hosting on AWS and Fastly CDN with automatic SSL
Sell physical and digital products with fully customizable checkout flows
Multiple editors, role-based permissions, and a content editor for non-technical teams

We use Webflow for client projects where design quality and iteration speed matter most. It bridges the gap between designers and developers, eliminating handoff friction. For startups that need to ship fast and look polished, it is hard to beat.
Our team can integrate Webflow into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
